proof_body:
by
  intro R M ι _ _ _ _ _ _ b N
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨bN⟩⟩ := N.nonempty_basis_of_pid b
  haveI : Module.Free R M := Module.Free.of_basis b
  haveI : Module.Finite R M := Module.Finite.of_basis b
  refine ⟨n, ?_, ⟨bN⟩⟩
  have h1 := Submodule.finrank_le N
  rw [Module.finrank_eq_card_basis bN, Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b] at h1
  simpa using h1
target_source: ∀ (R M ι : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Fintype ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (N : Submodule R M), ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ Fintype.card ι ∧ Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) R N)
